{"code":"def transform(grid):
 a=[r[:] for r in grid]; H=len(a); W=len(a[0]); from collections import Counter
 bg=Counter(x for r in a for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]

 seen=set()
 for i in range(H):
  for j in range(W):
   if (i,j) in seen or a[i][j]==bg: continue
   # component
   st=[(i,j)]; seen.add((i,j)); cells=[]
   while st:
    x,y=st.pop(); cells.append((x,y))
    for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
     u,v=x+dx,y+dy
     if 0<=u<H and 0<=v<W and (u,v) not in seen and a[u][v]!=bg:
      seen.add((u,v)); st.append((u,v))
   if len(cells)<20: continue
   co=Counter(a[x][y] for x,y in cells)
   base,n=co.most_common(1)[0]
   marks=[(x,y) for x,y in cells if a[x][y]!=base]
   if len(marks)!=1: continue
   x,y=marks[0]; r0=min(p for p,q in cells); r1=max(p for p,q in cells); c0=min(q for p,q in cells); c1=max(q for p,q in cells)
   hc=9 if base==3 else 4
   for q in range(c0,c1+1): a[x][q]=hc
   a[x][y]=marks and a[x][y]
   for xx in (x-1,x+1):
    if r0<=xx<=r1:
     for yy in range(max(c0,y-1),min(c1,y+1)+1): a[xx][yy]=7
   a[x][y]=marks and (4 if base==3 else 6)
 return a"}

{"code":"def transform(g):
 a=[r[:] for r in g]; H=len(a);W=len(a[0])
 for x in range(H):
  for y in range(W):
   if a[x][y] not in (4,6): continue

   c0=y
   while c0>0 and a[x][c0-1]==base:c0-=1
   c1=y
   while c1<W-1 and a[x][c1+1]==base:c1+=1
   r0=x
   while r0>0 and a[r0-1][y]==base:r0-=1
   r1=x
   while r1<H-1 and a[r1+1][y]==base:r1+=1
   hc=4 if m==6 else 9
   for q in range(c0,c1+1):a[x][q]=hc
   a[x][y]=m
   for xx in (x-1,x+1):
    if r0<=xx<=r1:
     for yy in range(y-1,y+2):
      if c0<=yy<=c1:a[xx][yy]=7
   a[x][y]=m
 return a"}
